module eq_comparator (
    input [3:0] a,
    input [3:0] b,
    output equal
);

wire x0, x1, x2, x3;
wire n1, n2, n3, n4;

assign x0 = ~(b[0] ^ a[0]);   // XNOR
assign x1 =  (b[1] ^ a[1]);   // XOR
assign n1 = ~(x0 & x1);       // NAND

assign x2 =  (b[2] ^ a[2]);   // XOR
assign x3 =  (b[3] ^ a[3]);   // XOR
assign n2 =  (x2 | x3);       // OR

assign equal = ~(n1 & n2);    // NAND

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);

  assign p1y = ~(((p1a & p1b) & p1c) & p1d);
  assign p2y = ~(((p2a & p2b) & p2c) & p2d);

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  input p1e,
  input p1f,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);

  assign p2y = (p2c & p2d) | (p2a & p2b);

  assign p1y = (~((~(p1d & p1e)) & p1f)) | (~((~(p1a & p1b)) & p1c));

endmodule
